## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Boston, United States. It starts at 285 Derby.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ahoy there mateys! Are you ready to embark on a swashbuckling adventure into the world of Real Pirates? Join us for an immersive experience that will transport you back to the Golden Age of Piracy.
>
> Located in Salem, Massachusetts, Real Pirates offers an unparalleled glimpse into the lives of some of history's most notorious pirates. With general admission, you'll have access to a treasure trove of artifacts, including authentic pirate weaponry, navigational tools, and personal belongings.
>
> The interactive exhibits will take you on a journey through pirate history, from their notorious raids on merchant ships to their fierce battles with the Royal Navy. Meet some of the most famous pirates of all time, like Blackbeard and Captain Kidd, and learn about their exploits and adventures.
>
> With activities for all ages, including treasure hunts and interactive games, Real Pirates is the perfect destination for families and pirate enthusiasts alike.
